row.title: CF-POSTURE-2: the deploy gateway and four more upload paths also turned Worker logs off
row.body: After CF-POSTURE-1 the live reading showed tenant-ps-core, tenant-ps-web and ultrastable-deploy-gateway with logs off: workers/core/deploygate/index.js, two Cloudflare adapters, the launcher's provisioner and scripts/cf_account.py build upload metadata outside deploy/ and site/, which was all the first static scan read. All send observability now and cfposture --check scans every tracked code file for upload metadata.
